anm_code_text: The password is right. Now enter the six-digit code of the authenticator app.
anm_text: With a passkey, or with password and the code of the authenticator app.
apps_text: The apps of the Speicherstadt. Each describes itself in a manifest; the Steuerzentrale knows only the manifest. What an app cannot do is listed as “not supported” with its issue.
audit_text: Every write with actor, time, target and reason. Append-only; nobody can change or delete an entry.
auftraege_text: What the Zentrale asked the agents to do. A job names an action of the manifest, never a command; it is idempotent and continues after a lost connection or is reported as failed.
bak_pruef_text: Health in a throwaway project, removed afterwards
bak_regel: A backup older than 26 h is a fault
bak_schluessel: one repository and password per installation
bak_text: The kind comes from the manifest (pg_dump, restic, volume or command), encrypted with restic to the operator's S3 target. A backup counts only once the weekly test restore in a throwaway project was green.
einl_passwort_hinweis: Optional. Without a password the account signs in with a passkey only; with a password (at least 12 characters) an authenticator app is needed too.
einl_text: {betreiber} invites to the Steuerzentrale, with the role {rolle}.
einr_abgemeldet: Not signed in: the setup needs the session of an invitation, the setup code or a sign-in.
einr_fertig: The second factor is set up.
einr_passkey_mit_passwort: With a password a passkey alone is not enough: it can be added once the authenticator app is set up.
einr_passkey_text: Sign in with fingerprint, face or security key
einr_text: A passkey is enough. Signing in with a password also needs the code of an authenticator app (TOTP). Until then nothing else can be reached.
einr_totp_ersatz: Backup codes, each usable once if the authenticator app is missing. Keep them safe now; they are not shown again.
einr_totp_ohne_passwort: Not needed without a password: signing in uses the passkey.
einr_totp_qr: QR code for the authenticator app
einr_totp_text: Required for signing in with a password
einst_aufbewahrung_daten_wert: Heartbeats and log excerpts 30 days, events 13 months, audit log permanently
einst_backup_text: one restic repository and password per installation; deleting a customer means deleting their repositories
einst_dns_text: Cloudflare, DNS only, no proxy; the token stays in the Zentrale, never on a server
einst_konten_text: Passkey or TOTP is required for every account
einst_melden_text: one message per fault, not per check
einst_rollen: Owner: everything · Technician: servers, installations, updates · Support: support access, log excerpt, restart
einst_signatur_wert: signed with minisign; the private key stays offline with the owner
einst_text: Operator values per app, backup target, DNS, notifications, accounts and the display.
einst_token_wert: set, rights: edit DNS of this zone
einst_werte_text: apply to all installations; a change creates the job “reconfigure” per installation
einst_zeitplan_wert: daily 03:00, staggered per installation, as a systemd timer on the server
einst_zertifikate_wert: HTTP-01 at the gateway, Let's Encrypt
ereig_text: Health, backups, updates, agents, checks and support access across all servers. Warnings and faults go out as set under Settings, one message per fault.
erst_text: The setup code is in the Zentrale's log at start. It is valid for 24 hours and once; with it the operator and its first owner are created.
fehler_abgeschlossen: The Zentrale is already set up.
fehler_code_ungueltig: The setup code is wrong or has expired.
fehler_einladung_ungueltig: This invitation is not or no longer valid.
fehler_email_vergeben: There is already an account for this email address.
fehler_falsch: Email address or password is wrong.
fehler_ungueltig: Please check the details: the password needs at least 12 characters.
fehler_zu_viele: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
hinweis_agent: Agent {zustand}, last seen {seit}; its installations have no state
hinweis_neustart: Reboot for kernel {kernel} needed; scheduled in the maintenance window at {zeit}
inst_aussen_text: DNS at Cloudflare, set by the Zentrale; checked independently of the agent
inst_einstellungen_text: Values per installation, operator values for all installations, and automatic ones the Zentrale creates and never shows again
inst_gekuendigt_text: Deletion on {datum}, after a final backup. Until the contract ends the app runs normally; read-only and export as far as its manifest offers them.
inst_snapshots_text: Kind from the manifest: {art} · restic to the operator's S3 target
inst_support_text: Access to this installation only with a support access: time-limited (2 hours by default), with a reason, in the audit log and the customer's events. It allows a log excerpt and a restart.
inst_text: Each app of a customer runs under its own Linux user with its own Podman Quadlets, network and volumes.
kunde_gekuendigt_text: Until then everything runs normally. Afterwards read-only and export as far as the apps can, otherwise the last backup for the customer; deletion on {datum}, after a backup. Nothing is deleted before the deadline.
kunde_verlauf_text: the customer sees these in the portal too
kunden_text: Customers, their contract and their installations. Customers never sign in here; they see their state in the portal.
leist_text: What each customer used in a month: installations, availability, data and support time. The portal writes the invoices.
nicht_gefunden_text: This page does not exist, or the object was removed.
pruefung_neustart_geplant: needed for the new kernel; scheduled in the maintenance window at {zeit}
server_ausstehend_text: unattended-upgrades installed these last night; the new kernel takes effect only after the reboot.
server_installationen_text: Installations: {n}, customers: {kunden}; each under its own Linux user
server_neustart_regel: A reboot runs only in the maintenance window and never in a freeze window of an app on this server.
server_ram_vergeben: Assigned by manifests: {vergeben} of {gesamt} GB RAM
server_text: Shared servers, dedicated servers and servers at the customer. Each runs the agent; it connects out by itself and reports every 30 seconds. unattended-upgrades installs security updates; the Zentrale schedules reboots in the server's maintenance window.
sla_basis_text: Updates with everyone else, after the internal wave
sperrzeiten_aktiv: Active now: {apps}; no updates and reboots.
sup_text: Access to an installation only for a limited time (2 hours by default), with a reason. An access allows a log excerpt and a restart, ends by itself and is in the audit log and the customer's events.
uebersicht_aufmerksamkeit_text: Faults and warnings: {n}, the worst first
uebersicht_text: What needs attention comes first; every entry leads to its cause.
upd_agent_fenster: checksum and signature, in the maintenance window at {zeit}
upd_agent_regel: The Zentrale understands agents one version back.
upd_plan_text: signed manifest since {seit} · before {vorher} · cancelled installations stay out
upd_regel: “all” starts 24 h after “internal” ends, if no fault came, and never in a freeze window.
upd_registry_text: a new tag without a signed manifest; no wave until it is imported
upd_schritt_image: Pull the image by digest, set it in the Quadlet unit
upd_schritt_nach_update: Commands after the update from the manifest
upd_schritt_neustart: Restart the units, wait for health
upd_schritt_zurueck: Health red: old version and backup back, stop the wave, report
upd_sperrzeit_aktiv: One is active today: no update for this app, no reboot on its servers.
upd_text: New versions with a signed manifest, rolled out in waves: first “internal”, then “all” once “internal” ran 24 hours without a fault. Never in a freeze window, and a backup runs before each installation.
upd_von_hand_text: No wave updates apps without health; only a person with a reason
welle_alle_text: everyone else, 24 h after “internal” without a fault
